name: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B
short: PrismML's 1.58-bit ternary-quantized 27B model derived from Qwen3.8-27B, fitting an ~8.6 GB memory footprint for consumer hardware inference with 262K context.
standout: Extreme 1.58-bit ternary quantization allows running a 27B-class model in under 9 GB of RAM with near-full capability retention.
tradeoff: Requires ternary kernel support (e.g. specialized llama.cpp or BitNet backends) for optimal throughput.
